cases.disease: Not stated (ATM-related rare disease; clinical exome diagnosis)
cases.mechanism_detail: L1 inserted near the splice site of ATM (c.169–4insL1), classified LPATH by ACMG criteria; 5' truncated by 8 bp. Functional/RNA effect not studied.
cases.quote: Fourteen MEIs were classified as pathogenic or likely pathogenic by applying American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG) criteria as previously described14 and confirmed by Sanger sequencing (Table 1).

cases.disease: Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer predisposition (secondary finding)
cases.mechanism_detail: Alu inserted within the coding sequence of BRCA2 (c.3407_3408insAlu), classified PATH by ACMG criteria; 5' truncated by 220 bp. Functional/RNA effect not studied. Reported as a secondary finding; same position/orientation as a previously reported BRCA2 Alu but 5' truncated by 220 bp.
cases.quote: The secondary finding MEI in another patient (Table 1) was of the same MEI family, in the same orientation, and in the same position as a pathogenic variant that was previously reported;8 however, Qian et al. reported a full length Alu while the Alu observed here was truncated at the 5’ end by 220 bp (Table 1).
